tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Validate an Ed25519-signed paxiom.receipt.v0 API delivery receipt (JSON Schema, Ed25519 signature, signer authorization via expectedIssuerPublicKeys / expectedPayTo, JCS or raw SHA-256 output binding, expiry, and settlement trust state) and return structured JSON fields. Use this instead of explain_

tools.name: explain_receipt
tools.description: Format a plain-text trust breakdown and next-action remediation checklist for an Ed25519-signed paxiom.receipt.v0 API delivery receipt. Use this instead of verify_receipt when displaying a readable verdict to a user or operator; use verify_receipt when code needs raw check fields for programmatic ga
